decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Deep white bowl remains on four narrow legs with a curved drain visible below.

rear.note: Rear view shows a continuous U-bend and seated tailpiece beneath the basin.

detail.note: Basin rim and molded bowl remain unchanged while drain collar closes the former gap.

underside.note: Trap follows a smooth continuous curve inside the leg footprint.

clay.note: Rounded plumbing now complements the recessed basin without hard zigzag elbows.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Smooth white lid and base surround the transparent cylindrical bowl.

rear.note: Rear shell silhouettes are circular without the former broad radial corners.

detail.note: Handle, dark display and interior star tray remain separate and visible.

underside.note: Base closes evenly beneath the bowl with a smooth outer rim.

clay.note: Densified molded housings retain the original compact appliance proportions.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Smoked glass disc sits directly on the tapered pedestal.

rear.note: Rear glass rim is smooth and the pedestal meets its lower foot.

detail.note: Top-to-pedestal joint has continuous contact without the former gap.

underside.note: Closed foot and smooth underside ring support the circular glass top.

clay.note: Round top, conical pedestal and stepped foot retain distinct profiles.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Headphones hang on the swept stand with recessed dark oval pads.

rear.note: Wooden cups and original open grille bars remain separate from the pads.

detail.note: Dark pad backing now hides the wooden cup face and leaves a clear ear recess.

underside.note: Stand foot supports the curved upright; pads have a thick rounded lip.

clay.note: Ear cavities and smoother stand replace flat pad discs and segmented support.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Clear jug and dark handle sit on the dial-equipped white motor base.

rear.note: Rear handle has continuous curved corners and attached upper and lower mounts.

detail.note: Jug markings and internal blades remain visible beside the smoother handle.

underside.note: Four rubber feet remain beneath the closed base with the jug mount intact.

clay.note: Rounded molded handle now follows a connected rectangular grip silhouette.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: White study chair has a continuous fine blue seat welt.

rear.note: Original ribbed back support and five-star base remain intact.

detail.note: Seat trim follows the cushion surface without broken or floating sections.

underside.note: Under-seat frame, controls and caster supports remain connected.

clay.note: Seated seam and soft cushion crown improve the existing chair construction.
